title: psilochenia occidentalis subsp. pumila
intro: Psilochenia occidentalis subsp. pumila, commonly known as the Western Yew or Pacific Yew, is a plant species that belongs to the genus Taxus and family Taxaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Psilochenia occidentalis subsp. pumila involve the modulation of cell signaling pathways, which may help to prevent the growth and spread of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include taxols, taxanes, and other diterpenoid compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
